stem:
Lalit measures a pencil on a ruler marked in centimetres. The tip ends between the 7 cm and 8 cm marks.

What should he do to report the length more accurately?

options.text: Report 7 cm, because the tip has not reached 8 cm.
Split the gap into unequal marks of any sizes he likes.
Split the 1 cm gap into equal smaller parts and count how many the tip passes.
Ignore the ruler marks and use only the printed number 7 on the pencil.

teacher.key_rationale: When the tip falls between whole marks, the unit interval is divided into equal smaller parts. Whole-unit estimate alone is too coarse. Unequal parts break the unit. A printed number on the pencil is not the measure.
